english: Where can I find the milk?
variationEnglish: Where can I find the bread?

text: Je voudrais deux petits pains, s’il vous plaît.
english: I would like two rolls, please.
variation: Je voudrais un café, s’il vous plaît.
variationEnglish: I would like a coffee, please.

english: Can I pay by card?
variationEnglish: Can I pay in cash?

english: How much does this bag cost?
variationEnglish: How much does this book cost?

text: Avez-vous aussi une taille plus petite ?
english: Do you also have a smaller size?
variation: Avez-vous aussi une taille plus grande ?
variationEnglish: Do you also have a bigger size?

text: Je n’ai pas besoin de sac.
english: I do not need a bag.
variation: Je n’ai pas besoin de ticket.
variationEnglish: I do not need a receipt.

text: Puis-je avoir le ticket, s’il vous plaît ?
english: May I have the receipt, please?
variation: Puis-je avoir un sac, s’il vous plaît ?
variationEnglish: May I have a bag, please?

english: These apples are cheaper.
variationEnglish: These pears are cheaper.

text: Je cherche un cadeau pour ma copine.
english: I am looking for a gift for my girlfriend.
variation: Je cherche un cadeau pour mon père.
variationEnglish: I am looking for a gift for my father.

english: I will take this one, thank you.
variationEnglish: I will take that one, thank you.

text: Pouvez-vous expliquer cela encore une fois, s’il vous plaît ?
english: Can you explain that again?
variationEnglish: Can you explain that slowly?

text: Je ne comprends pas cette question.
english: I do not understand this question.
variation: Je ne comprends pas ce mot.
variationEnglish: I do not understand this word.

english: What does this word mean?
variationEnglish: What does this sentence mean?

english: May I ask something quickly?
variationEnglish: May I say something quickly?

english: I have already done my homework.
variationEnglish: I have already done my exercise.

english: When do we have to hand this in?
variationEnglish: When do we have to read this text?

text: Mon stylo est sur la table.
english: My pen is on the table.
variation: Mon livre est sur la table.
variationEnglish: My book is on the table.

english: Tomorrow I am going to school.
variationEnglish: Today I am going to school.

text: Je suis en retard parce que mon train a du retard.
english: I am late because my train is delayed.
variation: Je suis en retard parce que mon bus a du retard.
variationEnglish: I am late because my bus is delayed.

english: Can we practise together?
variationEnglish: Can we study together?

text: De quel quai part le train ?
english: From which platform does the train depart?
variation: De quel quai part le train pour Gand ?
variationEnglish: From which platform does the train for Ghent depart?

english: Do I need to change trains here?
variation: Dois-je changer de train à Gand ?
variationEnglish: Do I need to change trains in Ghent?

english: Does this train go to Bruges?
variationEnglish: Does this train go to Brussels?

text: Je voudrais un billet pour Gand, s’il vous plaît.
english: I would like a ticket to Ghent, please.
variation: Je voudrais un billet pour Bruxelles, s’il vous plaît.
variationEnglish: I would like a ticket to Brussels, please.

text: À quelle heure arrive le train ?
english: What time does the train arrive?
variation: À quelle heure arrive le bus ?
variationEnglish: What time does the bus arrive?
